programme.title: F1 HL '25: Australian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Louis Vuitton Australian Grand Prix'. The Australian GP was the chaotic season opener, won by McLaren's Lando Norris from pole position after a dramatic race marked by mixed weather and multiple safety cars

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Chinese GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Chinese Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the Chinese main race from pole position, leading a McLaren one-two finish ahead of teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Japan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Japanese Grand Prix'. The Japanese GP was won by Max Verstappen, who fended off a race-long challenge from the two McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Bahrain GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Bahrain Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri of McLaren converted his pole position to a victory, ahead of George Russell of Mercedes and Piastri's teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Saudi Arabia GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - STC Saudi Arabian Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the 2025 Saudi Arabian GP, taking the WDC lead for McLaren. Verstappen took P2 despite a 5s penalty, with Leclerc P3.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Miami GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix'. Piastri storms to victory at the 2025 Miami GP, leading a McLaren 1-2 with Norris. Russell takes third as Verstappen slips to fourth after losing the lead on lap 14.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Emilia-Romagna GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - AWS Gran Premio Del Made in Italy E Dell'Emilia-Romagna'. Verstappen triumphs at Imola, winning the Emilia-Romagna GP ahead of Norris and Piastri.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Monaco GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Grand Prix De Monaco'. Norris won from pole, holding off Leclerc. Piastri P3. Verstappen P4 after a late tire gamble failed. Norris's win cut the title lead to 3 points in a strategic race.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Spanish GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Aramco Gran Premio De Espana'. Oscar Piastri controlled the race from pole position, leading a strong showing by McLaren. Lando Norris finished just a few seconds behind.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Canada GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Grand Prix Du Canada'. Russell claims pole-to-flag win in Montreal, with Verstappen second and rookie Antonelli third. Russell nabbed fastest lap, McLaren's Norris and Piastri collide late.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Austrian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Austrian Grand Prix'. Norris won at the Red Bull Ring. Piastri P2 ensured McLaren dominance on Red Bull's turf with Leclerc finishing P3.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: British GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways British Grand Prix'. Norris won a wet-dry home GP. Piastri P2, with Hulkenberg a shock P3 for Sauber.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Belgian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Belgian Grand Prix'. Piastri won at Spa. Norris P2, Leclerc P3. McLaren extended their Constructors' lead significantly over Red Bull.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Hungarian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Hungarian Grand Prix'. Lando Norris wins for McLaren, narrowly beating his teammate Oscar Piastri in a thrilling finish, marking McLaren's 200th F1 win.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Netherlands GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Dutch Grand Prix'. Piastri spoiled Verstappen's home party with a win. Verstappen P2, Hadjar a shock P3 for RB.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Italy GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Gran Premio D'Italia'. Verstappen won at Monza. Norris P2, Piastri P3. Ferrari missed the home podium as Leclerc finished P4.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Azerbaijan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix'. Verstappen mastered the Baku streets to win from pole. Russell P2, while Carlos Sainz took a maiden Williams podium in P3.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Singapore GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix'. George Russell converted pole into a brilliant win. Verstappen took P2 after holding off a fierce charge from Norris (P3).

programme.title: F1 HL '25: United States GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix'. Verstappen dominated the weekend, winning both the Sprint and the Grand Prix. Norris beat Leclerc to P2 after a thrilling late-race duel.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Mexico GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Gran Premio De La Ciudad De Mexico'. Norris won from pole, Leclerc took P2, while Verstappen fought from P5 to P3. Rookie Ollie Bearman secured a career-best P4 for Haas.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Sao Paulo GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Grande Premio De Sao Paulo'. Norris mastered the rain at Interlagos to win both the Sprint and Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli took a sensational P2 for Mercedes, with Verstappen P3.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Las Vegas GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix'. Verstappen won a cold, chaotic night race. Russell and Antonelli followed for a Mercedes 2-3. Both McLarens were disqualified for technical infringements.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Qatar GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix'. Verstappen won again after a McLaren strategy blunder. Piastri took P2 and Carlos Sainz scored a podium for Williams in P3.

programme.title: F1 HL '25: Abu Dhabi GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'. Verstappen won the race, but Norris's P3 was enough to secure the World Championship by just 2 points.
